cases.page_title: 10 Tips for Hosting a Great Potluck
cases.page_description: Make your next potluck effortless with these hosting tips.
cases.page_body:
10 Tips for Hosting a Great Potluck

1. Use a shared sign-up list so you don't end up with five pasta salads.
2. Ask guests to label dishes with ingredients for allergies.
3. Have serving utensils ready - guests always forget them.
4. Plan for seconds: people eat more at potlucks than you think.
5. Set up a drink station away from the food table to spread people out.
6. Keep hot dishes hot - borrow a couple of slow cookers.
7. Have to-go containers for leftovers.
8. Don't over-plan activities; conversation is the point.
9. Send a reminder two days before.
10. Take five minutes to enjoy your own party.
